findings.summary: packagedWgsl derived the checkout root by hand from dist/src/ while every sibling walks findRepositoryRoot; it now calls findRepositoryRoot(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))) — the import cycle with the store is benign, the walk being a hoisted declaration reached only at call time

the renderer lowerer's gpuDeformation branch re-asserted the two PBR vertex-stage lines that pinned-world-transform.ts asserts for every scene through PINNED_STAGE_MARKERS; the duplicate rows are gone with a pointer to the header's markers

five markers were spelled two or three times inside renderer-lowerer.ts (formula table, invariant loop, fidelity record), each its own packagedWgsl call; they are module constants (IBL_SPECULAR_OCCLUSION, BRDF_LUT_COORDINATES, ENVIRONMENT_CUBEMAP_ROTATION, PBR_SKYBOX_VIEW_RAY, CLEARCOAT_IBL_CONSERVATION, SHEEN_ALBEDO_SCALING) so a record cannot drift from its assertion
the image-processing `common` block was read, asserted and split in both shader-builtins-utility.ts and upstream-lower.ts; pinnedImageProcessingSource() reads it once and both lifts consume it
the `var<storage, read>` morph marker matched the pin's JSDoc, not its WGSL (the built template spells var<storage,read>); it goes through packagedWgsl so the WGSL is what is asserted

the remaining plain literals over tagged text in the renderer's tables were the pin's compact-in-source spellings beside tagged ones, with nothing saying which class a literal was; they go through packagedWgsl too (the same text either way), the one JavaScript-string marker the pin interpolates unminified is a named constant that says so, and the helper's doc states the three classes

the kept-placeholder convention (`\${worldExpr}` written escaped so the pin's own placeholder rides through the transform) was stated only in pinned-world-transform.ts; the two renderer-lowerer sites that keep placeholders now say it where they are used

packagedWgsl had no test while 68 markers depend on four contracts (whitespace-free identity, line break to one space, kept placeholder boundary, spliced value); test/pinned-wgsl-build.test.ts states them as literals and ties the fog read to the pin's own module text

the same `?raw`/miniray explanation was pasted at STOCK_DIALECT, at the cubemap-skybox anchors and in the helper's doc; the splat interface doc already classified both dialects, so the STOCK comment is gone, the skybox function doc carries one clause (spelling and mangled names), and the helper's doc states the rule once

packagedWgsl's error guarded an unreachable null branch under a message that misdiagnosed the one reachable failure (the extraction regex missing a changed output shape); one message prints what came back

docs/fidelity.md's fixed-frame paragraph named the platformer's frame 180 after being widened to torus-states (185) and carried before/after narration; it now says the registry's referenceFrame and states the mechanism only; the torus-states registry comment and the status row note were prose copies of the value and the doc and are reduced to the one fact the registry needs (why 185 and not the convention's 180)
the fog contract's doc comment quoted the packaged spelling the code no longer writes; it quotes the pin's source

PINNED_STAGE_MARKERS and SH_DIALECT evaluate packagedWgsl at module load, which runs the pinned transform in every importing process; measured at 9 ms cold (already paid by the first store read in a compile) and 0.2 s across the whole unit-test run for the three test files that construct no store
findings.blockedBy: a measurement showing the import-time load costs anything in a generation process; the only cost found is 0.2 s per npm test run, below what lazy getters would buy in indirection
findings.filedIn: docs/reviews/ (this record); the efficiency numbers are in the pull request

findings.summary: the cubemap-skybox and HDR-prefilter anchors over `?raw` files assert miniray's mangled identifiers (`struct e{`, `var c:texture_cube`), so a miniray upgrade that renames them refuses generation with no WGSL change; the capture-group form shader-builtins-background.ts and ibl-brdf-lut.ts already use would assert shape and read the name
findings.blockedBy: a miniray version change to measure against; the anchors are pre-existing contracts over text this port cannot regenerate (miniray is not installed and the corpus pins no version of it), so the rewrite wants its own differential sweep
